# `bg`

> Profile: core · Permission key: `[permission] bg`

Manage background shell jobs started with bash `background: true` or `schedule`. Actions: list (default), read (needs id), kill (needs id).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `list`, `read`, `kill` | no | list \| read \| kill (default list) |
| `id` | string | no | Job id (e.g. bg-1) for read/kill |
| `max_chars` | integer | no | Max characters of output for read (default 8000) |
